title: Only decorates first-level directory items
goal: Use the direct child element selector to add visual markup to a first-level directory of campus activities.
summary: > The left side matches the parent element, and the right side matches the child elements it directly contains. Items nested in lower-level lists retain their own styles.
tasks: Use > to select the li directly included in .agenda.
sets border-left: 4px solid #264a7c and padding-left: 12px for first-level directory items. Child projects remain as is.
hint: Both the first and second level projects use li. Check the concatenation of .agenda and li in the selector.

example.note: exhibition wall directly uses figure. Leave space between cards, and nested legends can maintain their own spacing.
